AGENDA
  Old Town La Verne Business Improvement District
  Advisory Board

  Monday, September 12, 2022 – 8:30 am
  2316 D Street– Cafe Wang

1. WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER-

  Board Members  City Representatives/Others Present
  Craig Walters, Chair  Eric Scherer, Com. Dev. Director
  Marianne Stark  Natalie Hiatt, Com. Dev. Admin. Clerk
  Micky Rehm
  Zuhey Espinoza
  VACANT

2. CALENDAR-
  Beer Walk  Sat. October 15, 2022
  Heart of the Foothills Open Streets  Sun. April 23, 2023

3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES July 11, 2022 and August 1, 2022

4. NEW BUSINESS
  A.  Board Vacancy – One application received
  B.  Transfer to Association

5. CONTINUED BUSINESS
  A.  Beer Walk Update
  B.  Mainiero Square Update

6. COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES
  C.  City Report (Eric Scherer): E/2nd Street Improvements Update
  D.  University Report (Zuhey Espinoza):
  E.  Marketing (Micky Rehm):
  F.  Chamber Report (Leah Skinner):
  G.  Social Media Update (Micky Rehm):
  H.  Financial Report:

7. PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be deferred to the

8. ADJOURNMENT – Monday October 3, 2022 at 8:30 am at 2316 D St. (Cafe Wang)
   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, July 11, 2022

1.  The meeting was called to order by Chairperson Craig Walters at 8:32 a.m.

  Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm, and Zuhey Espinoza.
  City Representative present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer and
  Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others present: Fang Wang, Ken Valmonte, and Hal
  Fredericksen.

2.  CALENDAR

  Beer Walk – Saturday, October 15, 2022

3.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES

  It was moved by Ms. Rehm and seconded by Ms. Espinoza to approve the minutes of
  April 4, 2022; May 2, 2022; and June 6, 2022. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A. Car Show Agreement – Chairperson Walters stated that the previous 2 year contract
  was extended due to the pandemic. Mr. Scherer stated that the promoter was contacted to
  negotiate a new contract. Mr. Hoelzel is requesting the BID pays for the following items:
  Traffic control plan (estimated cost $6,000), removal of the $750 Reserve Police Officer
  donation, the banner at a cost of (estimated cost $1,000).

  There was discussion between the board members and they agreed that the BID would
  not pay for the banner or provide cars at the corners. Mr. Scherer stated that no official
  vote would be taken at this time. Mr. Scherer will discuss with Mr. Hoelzel further.

  B. Board Vacancy – Mr. Scherer stated that the Board vacancy is still open and no
  applications have been received.

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  A.  Beer Walk – Ms. Rehm stated that there are already 18 participants and Russ of
  La Verne Brewing is helping coordinate the breweries. Ms. Rehm recommended
  portable restrooms be provided.

  Mr. Scherer stated that construction at Mainiero Square is expected to be done in
  time. He discussed a re-dedication ceremony and possibly re-naming the square.
  Ms. Zuhey said she would discuss a possible name change with President
  Lieberman or Avo Kechichian.

  1
 6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A.  City Report (Eric Scherer): None
  B.  University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): None
  C.  Marketing (Micky Rehm): None
  D.  Chamber Report (Leah Skinner): None
  E.  Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): None
  F.  Financial Report: None

7.  PUBLIC COMMENT
  (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be deferred to the following
  meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  No comments received.

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 9:08 a.m., to the next meeting to be held on Monday, August 1,
  2022 at 8:30 a.m. at Café Wang.

  Respectively submitted,

  _____________________
  Natalie Hiatt

  2
   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, August 1, 2022

The meeting began without a quorum at 8:30 a.m.

Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters and Zuhey Espinoza. City
Representative present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer. Others present:
Fang Wang, Ken Valmonte and Krista Chakmak.

As there was no quorum, no official business was conducted. There was general
discussion about the Beer Walk event.

The meeting ended at 9:00 a.m.

Respectively submitted,

_____________________
Natalie Hiatt
